resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the tower was removed in 1959. Rex's page, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the 2016 Clearwater list say it was destroyed in 1959. The 1959 loss is recorded as destroyed, with the register's wording noted. None of the sources says how the tower came down.
The register and Rex's page give a 40-foot pole; the 2016 Clearwater list gives 35 feet. No height_m is recorded because the sources disagree.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts (list compiled June 2016 by Margaret Sand and Cindy Schacher)

notes_for_editor: Brief's 1932 build and 1959 loss are supported by all four sources. The brief's 'destroyed' wording is supported by three of four sources; the register says removed. The 2016 Clearwater list gives a 35-foot pole where the others give 40 feet. Neither the Forest Service list nor the search summary says how the tower came down. The 2016 list shows one photo for the site, but no image URL was captured, so no photo is recorded. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page names the 1932 staffer and gives no later staffing.
